metadata.description: Personal collection of AI agent skills, mostly for Claude Code.

plugins.name: oaat
plugins.description: Walk through pending decisions, questions, concerns and risks strictly one at a time, without overwhelming the user.

plugins.name: sitrep
plugins.description: Turn all open items, risks and concerns into a temporary visual HTML situation report (priority matrix, dependency map, cards), built for visual thinkers with ADHD.

plugins.name: milestones
plugins.description: A per-project milestone tracker (.cache/milestones.json) with a /milestones table, a progress bar and a colour statusline segment that shows what is left and who must act.
